facts.clause: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
Champion takedowns and max stack Explosive Charge detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing […] magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for […] seconds.
This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back.
